label.en: How the storm ends (one of these)

note.zh: 辐射损伤达100%时立即290致命损伤；否则约5年（1785天）后按当时阶段得到292/293/294。殖民地失守时局势中止，同样按阶段结算。
note.en: Damage reaching 100% gives 290 at once; otherwise after about 5 years (1785 days) the current stage picks 292/293/294. If the colony is lost the situation aborts and resolves the same way.

label.zh: 风暴期间每月随机事件
label.en: Monthly random events during the storm

note.zh: 权重：无事250，210/213/误计算各5，250为10。误计算由隐藏214分派：215权重5；216仅当有生物助手岗位时权重15。
note.en: Weights: nothing 250, 210/213/Miscalculations 5 each, 250 10. Hidden 214 picks Miscalculations: 215 weight 5; 216 weight 15 only with bio-assistant (machine_nurse) jobs.

note.zh: 选择任一选项，该星球全部机器人口都会被消灭，局势随之结束。
note.en: Every option kills all robot pops on the planet; the situation then ends.

note.zh: 工程研究奖励与永久修正“防辐射部件”。
note.en: Engineering research and the permanent modifier Radiation-Hardened Components.

note.zh: 工程研究奖励。
note.en: An engineering research reward.

note.zh: 5年的“软件故障”修正。
note.en: The Software Damage modifier for 5 years.

notes.zh: 殖民地满25年时的随机殖民地事件（权重5/100，弱磁场星球×2）；仅机械帝国、机器单位人口过半的非首都殖民地，每个帝国一次。选择的保护范围决定局势的初始方式与初始损伤。
notes.en: Random colony event when a colony turns 25 (weight 5/100, x2 on weak-magnetic-field planets); machine empires only, non-capital colony with over half machine-unit pops, once per empire. The shielding choice sets the situation's starting approach and initial damage.

scope.zh: 恒星耀斑/地磁风暴完整故事：开端与保护选择、局势、生物战利品支线、每月随机事件、四种结局与护理所后续。
scope.en: Whole Solar Flare / Geomagnetic Storm story: opening and shielding choice, situation, bio-trophy side event, monthly random events, four endings and the care-home follow-up.
